blocks.prompt: 6. How many 6-digit numbers can be formed from the digits 7, 7, 8, 8, 9, 9?
blocks.explanation:
Har number mein chhe ke chhe digits istemal hone hain, aur teeno digits (7, 8, 9) do do dafa hain.
Plan: digits ko lafz ke letters ki tarah samjhein jin mein kuch dohraye gaye hain, aur 'objects not all different' wala formula lagayen.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: digits 7, 7, 8, 8, 9, 9.
Humein find karna hai: in sab se kitne 6-digit numbers ban sakte hain.
Tareeqa: \(\dfrac{n!}{n_1!\,n_2!\,n_3!}\), jahan \(n = 6\) aur \(n_1 = n_2 = n_3 = 2\).

Dohraye gaye digits ginein
\[n = 6,\quad 7 \to 2,\ 8 \to 2,\ 9 \to 2\]
Kyun: 7 do dafa, 8 do dafa aur 9 do dafa hai. Teeno groups ko yaad rakhna zaroori hai; ek bhi chhoot gaya to jawab ghalat ho jayega.

Formula lagayen
\[\dfrac{6!}{2!\,2!\,2!} = \dfrac{720}{8} = 90\]
Kyun: Do 7 aapas mein badlein to number wahi rehta hai; yahi 8 aur 9 ke saath. Har number 2 x 2 x 2 = 8 dafa gina gaya tha, is liye 8 se divide kiya. Koi digit 0 nahi, is liye har tarteeb sahi 6-digit number hai (0 se shuru hone ka masla nahi).
Dhyan dein: Sirf ek 2! se divide karna (360 aana) ghalat hai; har dohraye gaye group ka apna factorial neeche aata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{first digit 7: } \dfrac{5!}{1!\,2!\,2!} = 30\]
\[30 \times 3 = 90 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Pehla digit 7 rakh dein to baaqi 7, 8, 8, 9, 9 ki 30 tarteebein hain. Yahi 8 aur 9 se shuru hone wale numbers ke liye. 3 x 30 = 90. Computer se gin kar bhi 90 aaya.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key mein \(360\) likha hai. Yeh \(\dfrac{6!}{2!}\) hai, yani sirf ek \(2!\) se divide kiya gaya hai. Lekin 7, 8 aur 9 teeno do do dafa hain, is liye sahi jawab \(\dfrac{6!}{2!\,2!\,2!} = 90\) hai.
